messages:
ava: Quick callout: regression in staging where legacy agents (no handshake) cause short requests to be swallowed by the coalescer window. P99 climbed.
sam: Minimal repro?
ava: Agent without new header + 20-50ms work -> server treated deadline absent and used default 120ms coalesce window.
zhen: I saw this too. Also noticed headroom accounting got weird because we assumed no slot pinning, which made scheduler over-optimistic under bursts.
ravi: Concrete mitigations we discussed: (1) normalize incoming requests at front-door into a canonical enqueue shape, (2) synthesize a conservative deadline_hint when missing, (3) flag synthesized requests as kv_reserved=false to avoid KV overcommit.
marta: Normalizer is key. If downstream operators read canonical_deadline and kv_reserved they don't need to branch on agent version everywhere. Keep the normalizer hot and inline.
sam: For the synthesized deadline value proposal: min(tenant_min_slo, 75ms). It's conservative but prevents short requests getting long-batched.
zhen: Tradeoff: kv_reserved=false will hurt cache hit rate. But better than allowing headroom overcommit and tail latency spikes. We'll measure cache-miss delta.
ravi: Telemetry plan: counters enqueue.normalized, enqueue.synth_deadline, enqueue.kv_no_reserve; latency histograms split by handshake_source. Add response header X-RW-Compat: synthesized_deadline for visibility.
marta: Rollout: metrics-only read path for 24h, then enable synth per-tenant with a gradual ramp. If a tenant sees >5% synthesized for 30m auto-enable microwindow policy for them for 10m to protect SLOs.
ava: Tests: unit tests for normalizer logic + integ perf that mixes 10% legacy agents at scale to validate no headroom overcommit and acceptable tail latencies.
sam: Add config flag compat.microwindow (off by default) and an auto-toggle hook tied to the synthesized fraction metric.
zhen: infra-bot: queued job eng-runtime/compat-normalizer (unit + light perf). :robot_face:
marta: Note: do NOT change required Enqueue proto fields. Only optional headers and server-side normalize. We can't force agent rebuilds for Hosted.
ava: I'll open the PR for normalizer + telemetry and link it here. Ravi/Sam will own tests and auto-toggle code.
sam: Sounds good. We'll demo in next eng-runtime sync and confirm perf numbers. :thumbsup:
